Event

Transformations Workshop: Your First Year

Hosted by the CoSpark Center team

Your first year as a member sets the rhythm for everything after it. Join the Transformations team for a hands-on morning at the Center. We will walk through setting a contribution goal that fits your budget, reading your Points ledger, and planning how you’ll put your Boost Payments to work. Bring your questions, and bring a friend who is curious about CoSpark. Coffee and pastries provided.
